description.value: Afghani Kabul Kebab Donair is an Afghan restaurant on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, serving kabobs, kebabs, and donairs. It sits on one of Vancouver's busiest pedestrian and cycling corridors, with both indoor and outdoor seating. Vegetarian options are available, making it a flexible stop for mixed cycling groups.
